label: Dodola system
definition: A phage defense system in which an organism possesses a two-component Dodola locus represented by DolA and DolB profiles that can protect bacteria from bacteriophage infection.
observations: Dodola branch under phage defense system; distinct from individual dolA or dolB genes, DolA or DolB proteins, DefenseFinder HMM profiles, predicted source-database rows naming one Dodola locus, unresolved Dodola trigger or effector activities, and other phage defense systems.
